evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey spoke lines fan from small outlined agent-run dots into the package mirror; the dots themselves are only a few px across.
At the small viewer size the spokes become a grey haze and the agent-run dots shrink to ~4 px outlined circles that compression would smear or erase.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is very pale grey on near-white, plus a thin pale arrow and outline globe; low contrast at both sizes.
Thin-outlined document icons overlap the 'Package mirror' label, leaving it greyed and partly obscured.
Title, timeline text and insight card use generous, high-contrast type; no texture or grain anywhere.

rationale: Type and cards are generous and there is no grain, but the core diagram is built from many 1 px grey hairlines and tiny outlined dots that compression and the 1288x598 window turn into haze. The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small faint text on near-white. That matches the fail descriptor (hairlines and small faint text).
